minimal_adr_draft.decision: For first launch, stage3 video-QA count is satisfied from verified CLEVRER CC0; LLaVA-Video-178K direct media/labels are not admitted for main commercial training. The 5k LLaVA-style bucket is either deferred or regenerated with the allowed teacher on already admitted CC0/BY media.
minimal_adr_draft.title: Stage3 remaining video media source substitution for first launch

clevrer.recommended_use: Use train split for 12k training rows; reserve validation for dev/calibration if needed; do not use public test questions for supervised training because answers are absent.

perception_test.known_counts: LLaVA card reports 1,803 PerceptionTest open-ended QA items; MVBench has 4,000 public rows total across mixed sources, including Perception tasks.
perception_test.reason: Original stage3 12k row described NExT-QA/STAR/CLEVRER; Perception is staged as eval/source candidate and needs root policy admission before training reuse.

star_mvbench.reason: STAR raw media is Charades; Charades license is non-commercial and forbids public modified data redistribution. Existing archive is research/eval only.

recommended_first_launch_plan.llava_5k_replacement: Requires minimal ADR: replace/directly defer LLaVA-Video-178K 5k with allowed-teacher soft labels over admitted CC0/BY media, primarily CLEVRER plus any future Perception/NExT/VGG filtered media that passes rights checks.
recommended_first_launch_plan.quality_preservation: Do not reduce row counts; preserve diversity by reserving slots for future admitted sources, but first-launch can meet the hard 12k video-QA count with CLEVRER and keep the 5k LLaVA-style bucket ADR-gated rather than blocked.
recommended_first_launch_plan.video_qa_12k: Use CLEVRER train split only: deterministic sample 12,000 rows grouped by scene_index/video, preserving family isolation; validation split remains dev/calibration; test split excluded from supervised training.

executable_plan: If the 5k row bucket must remain, generate it as allowed-teacher soft labels over already admitted CC0/BY media instead of using LLaVA media/labels directly.
If root wants LLaVA research-only, select 5k metadata rows from pinned JSON groups after source-provenance filtering; no bulk tarball download.
llava_video_178k.main_training_requirement: do not download full 1.28TB and do not admit to commercial main training under current rights
llava_video_178k.rights_status: Dataset card declares Apache-2.0 but also restricts use to academic research and education; source media include academic/youtube/borrowed datasets with separate terms.
